mapper.select: select id, user_id, house_id, enabled, advance_days, notify_overdue, task_types, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from reminder_preferences where user_id = #{userId} and house_id = #{houseId} limit 1
mapper.update: update reminder_preferences set enabled = #{enabled}, advance_days = #{advanceDays}, notify_overdue = #{notifyOverdue}, task_types = #{taskTypes}, update_by = #{updateBy} where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId} and house_id = #{houseId}
